subject: Station Zero v3 reference experiment / current retained machine Product Value evidence

lanes.method: same-seed paired Runs differing only by first-Turn objective-relevant scan vs hold command
three representative deterministic full Runs with relevant-state same-context counterfactual control probes

retainedConsequences.scope: current Station Zero v3 reference-experiment product behavior under current targeted-control opportunity semantics
retainedConsequences.reason: The 0/46 result is not sufficient evidence that lootPolicy wiring is defective. Current scoring consumes lootPolicy, focused order-comprehension evidence shows it can alter selection in a meaningful medkit state, the player UI already withholds the rejected control, and broad pickup-candidate existence is not equivalent to meaningful downstream loot opportunity.
reopenWhen: one or more source fences become stale
optional-item semantics gain new downstream affordances or utility
a narrower meaningful-loot opportunity evaluator finds contradictory leverage evidence
the player-facing product surface reintroduces lootPolicy

boundaries: Machine Product Value evidence may establish causal control, information, pressure, strategy or behavioral consequences; it does not establish Human Player Value.
One evaluator result is pressure, not authority. Opportunity semantics and current standing must be checked before product mutation.
A retained NO_CHANGE is scoped and currentness-fenced; it is not a permanent prohibition on future loot mechanics.
